title: Graphic Designer I
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

You’re a brand designer with a strong focus on print and editorial, and you enjoy bringing brands into the physical world. You think beyond the screen, considering how a design will translate to a 20-foot vinyl wrap, event signage or printed piece. You’re equally comfortable supporting digital work, from social templates to landing page graphics, and you apply strong design fundamentals across every touchpoint. You’re curious, proactive and detail-oriented, digging into problems and catching the small things that make a big difference in the final execution.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Designing large scale print materials including event signage, vinyl wraps, window wraps and booth design for hosted and sponsored events

  • Producing print marketing materials such as flyers and signage that stay on brand and print ready

  • Preparing print ready files with correct bleed, trim, color mode and vendor specs across InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop

  • Supporting layout and design work in Figma as needed to keep print and digital brand consistent

  • Contributing to new brand initiatives from concepting to launch

  • Partnering with the events and marketing ops teams to understand space, scale and install requirements before finalizing designs

  • Coordinating with print vendors and reviewing proofs to catch issues before they become expensive mistakes

  • Applying HighLevel brand guidelines consistently across every physical and print touchpoint

  • Taking feedback on assigned projects and applying it quickly to keep production timelines on track

What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, this is the most important skill for this role

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

  • Working knowledge of Figma

  • A portfolio that shows real print production experience, not just digital mockups of print pieces, digital branding samples are a plus

  • Understanding of print fundamentals including bleed, trim, color profiles, file setup and vendor requirements for large format printing

  • Comfort moving between print and light digital branding work without missing a beat

  • Sharp attention to detail, you catch the small things before they turn into big and expensive problems

  • A curious, hands on problem solving mindset, you want to understand how something gets built and installed, not just how it looks in a file

  • Ability to work independently on problems of limited scope while learning to apply company standards and processes

  • Comfortable receiving direct feedback and iterating quickly

Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • 1-3 years of professional design experience, internships and apprenticeships included

  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, visual communication or a related field preferred, equivalent experience and a strong portfolio will be considered

  • Required portfolio showcasing print and editorial design work, large format or event based work and digital branding samples

  • Ability to balance speed, creativity, quality and business priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • High attention to detail and commitment to producing polished, professional content.

  • Based in Mexico

title: Brand Designer,  Product Launches
region: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for a Brand Designer who can establish a clear visual direction for product storytelling and drive it through to execution: someone with a narrative mindset expressed visually, who can turn complex product strategy and feature detail into a story people actually feel for major product launches.

You'll partner closely with product marketing, strategists, copywriters, designers, product designers, and motion designers to create storyboards, styleframes, and visual directions that translate product strategy and features into captivating stories across launches and key product moments.

This role is ideal for a designer who thinks in stories, loves the intersection of design and motion, and wants to shape how Figma's product shows up in the world, with clarity, emotion, and craft.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Turn product strategy, market context, and feature complexity into storyboards and styleframes that carry the launch story
  • Partner with copywriters, designers, motion designers, strategists, and producers to build narrative-driven assets across launches
  • Help evolve Figma's visual storytelling system and apply it consistently
  • Own visual direction on launch storytelling projects from early concepting to final delivery
  • Push new visual formats and directions; don't just execute the existing playbook

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • A portfolio that shows strong visual point-of-view carried through to finished execution, across mediums, with examples of styleframes, storyboards, and concepting; spec work with fake brands or products is welcome
  • A background distilling a business or strategy brief down to a single compelling idea, and driving that idea forward into execution
  • Experience collaborating with motion designers, production teams, product marketing teams, and product design teams
  • A strong sense of composition, color, and pacing, especially in motion contexts, used in service of clarity, not abstraction
  • Proficiency in Figma (After Effects a plus, but not required)

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Ability to create basic animations or motion tests independently
  • Interest in researching and experimenting with new tools, workflows, and technologies
  • Experience working on product launch films, explainer videos, or product walkthroughs
  • Ability to translate strategic complexity and feature detail into a story worth telling
  • A genuine understanding of and connection to Figma's values and mission — someone who is curious about the product and passionate about understanding it
  • Comfortable setting visual direction and seeing it through, driving the work autonomously when needed
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
